'''Stantorrs''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], [[Ula Vii]], secretly an [[Imperial Agent]], reported to Stantorrs directly and was assigned as envoy by Stantorrs himself to go to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. At one point, Stantorrs asked [[Larin Moxla]] about the actions of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Pipalidi]] of the attack force on [[Sebaddon]] because he was considering promoting the captain to [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]]. He was replaced by [[Rans]] as [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]].
